rustcraft.world.map.v2.welcome: RustCraft: /rustmap info shows map status and island locations. /rustmap tp spawn goes to the center. Operator: /rustmap build; /rustmap repair fixes oil-rig ladders.
rustcraft.world.map.v2.done: RustCraft island ready: mountains, building clearings, roads and seven monuments. Locations: /rustmap info. Respawns are random unless a working bed is available.
rustcraft.world.map.v2.started: Building a new island. The old map stays in its own region. Progress: /rustmap status.
rustcraft.world.map.layout: Island layout: %s; land footprint up to %s × %s blocks.
rustcraft.world.map.repair_started: Repairing oil-rig docks, entrances and ladders. Other map areas stay in place.
rustcraft.world.map.repair_unavailable: No oil rig found, or the map is currently building/repairing. Check /rustmap status.
rustcraft.world.map.repaired: Oil rig repaired: sea-level dock, continuous ladders and clear deck exit.
